Crew size NOT explicitly confirmed (rep mentioned 'three mover team' in pricing context but did not re-confirm at booking). Crew notes about customer concerns NOT recorded (no 'heavy art' or 'patio umbrella' concern flagged for crew).

top_strength: Excellent logistics and detail discovery — Jack systematically probed bedrooms, furniture, shed contents, access/steps, and special items, building a complete picture that allowed him to confidently downsize the original estimate and assure the customer the move would likely fit on one truck.
coaching_note: You skipped the entire Section 2 (Their Agenda / Two Layers Deep / Reflection) and Section 5 (Two Promises) entirely, and never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or a genuine final-concerns check — focus on asking for the customer's non-price concerns early, delivering the On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage before moving to the ask, and confirming phone number and addresses at booking.
